text:
Sam: quick heads-up — PR #1987 (db rollout flag + small migration) is green locally but mac builders are stuck in CI. We need this merged before the maintenance blackout starts Tue 00:30 UTC. Can someone take eyes and/or grab a CI slot? :wave:

Jen: pinging @Alex for review, should be quick — mostly a schema tweak and a feature flag toggle. :eyes:

Alex: looking now. small question: migration is additive, right? any manual rollback steps?

Sam: yes additive. rollback is just toggling the flag and running the reverse statement if needed. snippet:```sql
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN onboarding_version integer DEFAULT 0;
-- rollback: ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN onboarding_version;
```

Maria: ci-bot reports mac-12 is queued, but there is a backlog on mac-11 too. If we wait, we might miss the blackout. Can we rerun in a different pool?

devops-bot: @channel Maintenance blackout window scheduled Tue 00:30-01:15 UTC for infra upgrades. Avoid merges that trigger stateful migrations during this window.

Alex: ok — approve pending one tiny lint and unit test tweak. Sam can you address and push? if you push, I'll re-run tests and merge if green.

Sam: pushed fix for the lint and added a minimal unit test. re-requesting CI run.

ci-bot: Build started: mac-11, mac-12, linux-x86_64. mac-11: started. mac-12: waiting (pool busy).

Jen: if mac keeps blocking, we can gate merge to linux + a fast canary in prod for 10% traffic, then flip once mac passes. But that needs a short rollout plan in the PR description.

Alex: I'm fine with the canary approach for this migration since it's additive — please document rollback steps in PR and add the rollout flag. I'll merge on green. :thumbsup:

Sam: added rollout notes and rollback steps to PR body + `--dry-run` command for staging. pinging for merge once mac passes or if we decide to canary.

ci-bot: mac-11: passed. linux-x86_64: passed. mac-12: failed (transient errno during brew install).

Maria: mac-12 failure looks like infra flake. @devops-bot can you requeue mac-12 or move to a different mac host?

devops-bot: Requeued mac-12 job and requested a different host. ETA next slot ~15m.

Jen: thanks — if it's still not green in 20m we should do the canary merge to keep the rollout on track and avoid the blackout. everyone ok with that?

Alex: OK with canary. Sam, add canary flag and I'll proceed to merge after linux + mac-11 pass.

Sam: done. thanks all. I'll monitor and roll back flag if anything odd shows up. :pray:

ci-bot: mac-12: passed on re-run. All checks green.

Alex: merging now. good luck with rollout. :shipit:

Sam: merged and triggered canary rollout (10%). watching logs and metrics.

Maria: noted. will keep an eye on latency dashboards and paging thresholds.

Jen: great coordination — nice move on the canary plan to avoid the blackout. :tada:
